item.title: Trump says US-Israeli war on Iran will be over ‘very soon’
item.description: US president speaks in Florida after a call with Putin, who said he wanted to be 'helpful' on Middle East war.

item.title: Where do the 35 million foreigners living in the GCC come from?
item.description: More than half of the 62 million people in the six Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries are foreign workers.

item.title: US blacklists Sudanese Muslim Brotherhood as ‘terrorist’ group
item.description: Trump administration accuses the group of receiving support from Iran and carrying out violence against civilians.

item.title: World reacts to appointment of Mojtaba Khamenei as Iran’s supreme leader
item.description: New supreme leader receives support from Oman, Iraq, Yemen's Houthis, while the US and Israel make threats.

item.title: Qatar releases video of interception of Iranian missiles
item.description: Footage released by the Qatari Ministry of Defence shows Iranian missiles and drones being intercepted over the country.

item.title: Trump slams Mojtaba Khamenei’s appointment as Iran projects defiance
item.description: US president, who had warned against selecting Mojtaba Khamenei to lead Iran, says new supreme leader may not 'last'.

item.title: Who is Iran’s new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei?
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei replaces his assassinated father Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Putin says Russia can supply oil, gas to Europe as energy prices soar
item.description: Russian president spoke as oil prices surged past $100 per barrel, reaching levels unseen since start of Ukraine war.

item.title: Why Israel’s war on Hezbollah keeps returning
item.description: Israel has tried for decades to weaken Hezbollah through wars and assassinations. Why has the group endured?

item.title: What is Trump’s endgame in Iran as the US-Israel war escalates?
item.description: As strikes continue across Iran, US President Trump has articulated shifting goals. But how likely are they?

item.title: What to know about Iran’s new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
item.description: The son of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei will now leader Iran through the biggest crisis in the country's modern history.

item.title: Anthropic sues Trump administration to undo US ‘supply chain risk’ tag
item.description: In its lawsuit, Anthropic said the designation was unlawful and violated its US free speech and due process rights.

item.title: WHO chief raises alarm after Israeli attacks on Iranian oil facilities
item.description: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says children, the elderly at particular risk after damage to Iranian petroleum facilities.

item.title: How the Iran war is affecting Africa
item.description: Before the start of the war between Israel, US and Iran, Africa was on track for its biggest economic moment in history.

item.title: Australia grants asylum to five Iranian women footballers
item.description: Players' union FIFPRO expresses serious concerns for team after criticism of them not singing anthem before first match.

item.title: France preparing to escort ships in Strait of Hormuz when war calms: Macron
item.description: French president says 'purely defensive' mission aims to gradually reopen key Gulf waterway amid spike in oil prices.

item.title: US senators demand probe into ‘appalling’ attack on girls’ school in Iran
item.description: Top Democrats say Minab school bombing that killed at least 170 people 'must be fully and impartially reviewed'.

item.title: US military kills six in strike on alleged drug boat in the Eastern Pacific
item.description: The US military claims six men killed in a strike on a suspected drug-smuggling boat in the eastern Pacific Ocean.

item.title: Turkiye says Iranian ballistic missile intercepted by NATO air defences
item.description: Ministry of National Defence says no casualties or damage after missile shot down over southern city of Gaziantep.

item.title: What defence support could Ukraine offer Middle East states amid Iran war?
item.description: Ukraine has built low-cost drones to counter Russian attacks with imported Iranian Shahed drones.

item.title: Iran authorities support continuity with backing for Mojtaba Khamenei
item.description: The IRGC says its forces are ready to 'fully obey and sacrifice for the divine commands' after new supreme leader named.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian journalist Amal Shamali in Gaza attack
item.description: Shamali, who worked for Qatar Radio, killed in an Israeli air strike on central Gaza's Nuseirat refugee camp.

item.title: Israeli attacks on Iran fuel sites aim ‘to break resilience of people’
item.description: As toxic clouds and rain smother Tehran, analysts say Israel’s aims is to break the resilience of the Iranian people.

item.title: Fear, uncertainty surround Iran women’s football team’s return home
item.description: Players body and activists say the team must be protected while head coach insists the players are eager to return.

item.title: Israel strikes Hezbollah financial institutions as Lebanon calls for talks
item.description: Israel strikes Al-Qard al-Hasan branches; Lebanese president says ready to resume negotiations to halt escalation.
